name: OS3
long_description:
OS3 deploys US-built mobile semi humanoid robots for repetitive physical work.

We designed the robot, custom actuators, model and control stack as one system, then pretrained the model exclusively on 150,000 hours of video data spanning more than 2,000 tasks. Hospitality is our first deployment vertical. Through our Startup Partner program, teams are deploying OS3 robots in biotech, hospitals and data centers.

Our two-person team built the robot and trained its first model in four months. We are making American robotics accessible to more businesses.
one_liner: Deploying US-Built Humanoid Robots & Training Video Action Models
